title: Compressor anti-surge recycle
goal: A process engineer can trace the compressor recycle path and identify the low-flow anti-surge final element.

rubric.must: V-301, K-301, E-301, and NRV-301 form a visible suction-to-discharge process path.
A visible recycle pipe branches from compressor discharge through FV-301 and returns to the suction vessel.
FT-301 and FIC-301 visibly connect to FV-301 with distinct electric and pneumatic signal lines.
FV-301 visibly shows a diaphragm actuator and FO fail position.
PT-301 and PIC-301 are visibly associated with compressor discharge pressure.
PSV-301 is visibly connected to the compressor discharge.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the pid exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The drawing visibly presents a complete compressor train and anti-surge recycle system. The main process runs from V-301 through K-301, FE-301, E-301, NRV-301, and the discharge header. A DN100 recycle branch returns compressor discharge gas through fail-open control valve FV-301 to V-301. The flow-control and pressure-monitoring instrumentation and required signal types are visible.

items.evidence: A continuous left-to-right process line visibly connects V-301 Suction Scrubber, K-301 Centrifugal Compressor, E-301 Aftercooler, NRV-301 Discharge Check, and DISCHARGE HEADER.

A visible DN100 anti-surge recycle pipe branches from the discharge line downstream of FE-301, passes through FV-301, and returns left to the inlet connection on V-301; the arrow shows flow toward the vessel.
FT-301 is connected by a dashed electric signal to FIC-301, and FIC-301 is connected to the FV-301 actuator by a separate solid line with pneumatic slash marks.
FV-301 visibly has a diaphragm actuator and the fail-position marking FO.
PE-301 and PT-301 are visibly connected to the compressor discharge line, with an 8 barg annotation, and PT-301 has a dashed electric signal connection to PIC-301.
PSV-301 is visibly connected by a vertical minor-process branch to the compressor discharge line and is labeled Set 10 barg.
